provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-09: The Chitterwood Walks, Part 1: Scrambling the Tribes The background art is of Zarta Dralneenm dressed in a smart red jacket, as she moves pieces around a battle map while her wayfinder illuminates the scene, with Pathfinders and Andoren soldiers moving in the background of a busy war camp. The overlaying art is of a goblin wearing a mask made up of a gourd
